explanation:
The central tree retains the value boundary, parsing dependencies, revision flow, edit consumers, and ownership model while shrinking from 103 to 66 lines (35.9%) and from 7206 to 4663 characters (35.3%). Five peripheral trees branch from the concepts they expand. M denotes modular structure, C calls, O ownership, and D data dependency; these perspectives can coexist within a tree. Positions use measured text dimensions with gaps between all diagram rectangles.

All code claims use the pinned sources in context.json. Parser detail comes from diagramContent.ts, diagramContentNodes.ts, asciiTree.ts, asciiGraph/parseAsciiGraph.ts, and interpreter/index.ts. Evidence joins use diagram.ts; identity continuity uses diagramRevision.ts, diagramRevisionEditor.ts, and diagramRevisionStore.ts; scope and connections use diagramSubtreeEdit.ts and diagramConnection.ts. Details absent from the seed include interpreter explanations, frame borders excluding edges, precise subtree gap rules, jump-view projection, and asymmetric connection endpoint types.

Corrections and qualifications: retainMappings is exposed on patches and replace, not single patch. Connection collection validation accepts any differing content revision; it does not establish that the revision is older. The seed's relative-path claim is stronger than validateDiagram's actual guard: it rejects leading '/' and '..' segments but does not reject every absolute-path form. Subtree range calculation uses node anchor lines and root fold ranges, without consulting multiline spans. Durable flush-before-publication is a documented adapter contract, not an implementation shown here. Imported helpers and registry internals absent from the supplied sources remain outside the evidence boundary.

diagrams.ascii:
Immutable Diagram Model - shared by canvas, agents, history, and storage
|-- [M] Value boundary: Diagram + DiagramRevision
|   |-- Diagram identities and payload
|   |   |-- diagramId: stable service ID; id: local canvas content key
|   |   |-- revisionId: service revision ID; revision: content revision number
|   |   |-- content: ASCII + SHA-256 + content revision ID + versioned structure
|   |   |-- sourceContext: content hash + mappings + evidence + optional binding
|   |   `-- optional highlights and jumps
|   |-- DiagramRevision: id + diagramId + parentId? + diagram + nodeRefs
|   |   `-- nodeRefs maps revision-scoped content node IDs to logical identities
|   `-- Public operations expose values and views; editor lookup stays private
|       |-- createDiagram / reviseDiagram / deriveDiagram return revision results
|       `-- resolve returns a cloned view with logical node IDs
|-- [D] ASCII and parser version determine the common node model
|   |-- buildDiagramContent validates text, hashes it, and selects structure
|   |   |-- printable ASCII + LF; maximum 20000 characters
|   |   `-- blank text allowed only for a rectangular diagram placeholder
|   |-- Tree: stored nodes, roots, parent/child links, geometry, fold ranges
|   |   |-- parseAsciiTree calls the shared interpreter with compatibility
|   |   `-- visibleContentLines hides fold ranges for collapsed node IDs
|   |-- Diagram: diagramContentNodes derives an index from ASCII
|   |   |-- ascii-graph-1 uses parseAsciiGraph; multiline spans are retained
|   |   `-- missing parserVersion uses legacy mixed-dialect interpretation
|   `-- Defaults: ascii-tree-2 / ascii-graph-1; rebuilds preserve parser version
|-- [D] validateDiagram checks content and its attached evidence
|   |-- rebuild with pinned parser; require exact canonical JSON equality
|   |-- sourceContext.contentHash must equal SHA-256 of content.ascii
|   |-- mappings join evidence entities and indexed source ranges
|   |-- validate evidence ranges, optional source binding, and local mappings
|   `-- validate highlights and jumps; diagramSource exposes evidence queries
|-- [C] Revision creation and editing
|   |-- createDiagram: prepareCreate -> constructDiagram -> issueDiagramRevision
|   |-- reviseDiagram resolves the base through editor context bindings
|   |   |-- source-mappings: check expected ASCII hash; clone source data
|   |   |-- patch / patches: delegate range edits to patchDiagramRanges
|   |   |-- replace: construct next content revision; rebase annotations
|   |   |-- highlights / jumps: validate supplied annotations
|   |   `-- retainMappings is available on patches and replace
|   |-- unchanged diagram object returns the base revision
|   |-- otherwise keep diagramId and allocate a new service revisionId
|   |-- deriveDiagram accepts identities from revisions of the same diagram
|   `-- issueDiagramRevision is internal
|       |-- link parentId; assign reused, inherited, or fresh logical identities
|       `-- deep-freeze record -> validateDiagram -> return correspondence
|-- [M+D] Edit boundaries and consumers share diagramContentNodes
|   |-- Subtree replacement resolves revision-pinned roots and childIds
|   |   |-- reject noncontiguous subtrees, overlapping targets, and stale revisions
|   |   `-- scopedReplacements preserves every line outside selected ranges
|   |-- Identity continuity requires proven old-to-new node correspondence
|   |   |-- unchanged ASCII/kind permits exact geometry-and-label matching
|   |   `-- explicit claims must identify unique old and output nodes
|   |-- Connections use content-node anchors and optional box targets
|   |   |-- deleted boxes remove edges; proven mappings rebase endpoints
|   |   `-- unchanged ASCII/kind permits fallback; otherwise anchors stay stale
|   `-- merge rejects any baseline/current binding difference: MERGE_REQUIRED
`-- [O] Ownership and retention are explicit
    |-- Domain operations produce frozen revisions without storing them
    |-- Editor receives revision records and a context-binding callback
    |   `-- resolve clones its view; immutable revision payload stays internal
    |-- Private WeakMap caches derived diagram nodes by content object
    |   `-- derived nodes are frozen; tree nodes come from stored structure
    `-- Runtime store retains results through import -> registry.register
        |-- each current node needs a nonempty, unique logical reference
        |-- get/list expose retained revisions and frozen summaries
        |-- stored command wrappers combine domain operations with retention
        `-- durable flush before binding publication is an adapter contract

Parser boundary - ASCII to content nodes [M+D]
|-- Stored tree nodes: buildDiagramContent -> parseAsciiTree
|   |-- parseDiagram: tree dialect; ascii-tree-1 or ascii-tree-2
|   |-- tree/wire tolerance = 0; separate continuations; no repairs
|   |-- ID = content revision + ASCII hash + line
|   `-- fold ends before next peer, or at end of text
|-- Derived diagram nodes: diagramContentNodes
|   |-- ascii-graph-1 -> parseAsciiGraph
|   |   |-- frame borders separate cells; never carry graph edges
|   |   |-- text segments assemble into boxes with parent/child links
|   |   |-- wire components produce directed or undirected edges
|   |   `-- output coordinates are 1-based and inclusive
|   |-- graphNodes projects boxes only; parsed edges are not copied
|   |   |-- ID suffix uses first text span's line and column
|   |   `-- lines retains all text spans; foldRanges is empty
|   `-- no version -> legacyNodes -> mixed parseDiagram
|       `-- separate continuations; no repairs; first-span geometry
|-- Shared interpreter call sequence [C]
|   `-- normalizeSource -> recognize -> interpretLayout
|       `-- interpretTrees -> interpretWires -> return interpretation
`-- explainNode exposes decisions and supporting diagnostics
    |-- include decisions for the node and its incident edges
    `-- include related repairs and overlapping/alternative unresolved items

Source evidence joins and checks [M+D]
|-- diagramSource -> queryDiagramSourceContext
|   |-- mapping.entityId -> evidence entity
|   |-- mapping.sourceRangeIndex -> entity.sourceRanges entry
|   `-- return mapping + entity + range + optional binding
|-- Queries
|   |-- entries joins every mapping; forSelection first filters mappings
|   `-- search: case-insensitive substring over ID, label, path, symbol
|-- validateDiagram
|   |-- mapping must resolve; truthy sourceRangeId must match range.id
|   |-- evidence entry.id equals its key; label and sourceRanges required
|   |-- range: integer start >= 1; end >= start; string originalLines
|   |   `-- originalLines count equals end - start + 1
|   |-- path guard rejects leading '/' and '..' path segments
|   |   `-- does not reject every absolute-path form, e.g. drive paths
|   `-- if both are present, entry.sourceId must match binding.sourceId
`-- Source binding
    |-- source-code pairs with git-worktree; document with filesystem-documents
    |-- root must start with '/' or a drive letter plus ':' and slash
    `-- sourceBindingFromLocation derives sourceId from corpus kind + root
        `-- hash prefix is 24 hex characters; gitRevision is optional corpus data

Subtree scope is a line-range contract [D+C]
|-- diagramSubtreeRange
|   |-- find current node; recursively visit childIds
|   |-- end = max(descendant anchor lines, root fold-range ends)
|   |-- reject unrelated nodes whose anchors lie inside that range
|   `-- calculation does not inspect multiline node spans
|-- diagramReplacementRanges
|   |-- diagram: reject subtree targets; return no restricted ranges
|   |-- subnode-single: one subtree argument, no subtrees array
|   |-- multi modes: at least two targets; no single subtree argument
|   |-- all targets must match content.revisionId
|   |-- sort ranges; reject overlap and repeated targets
|   |-- multi-contiguous: gaps may contain only blank lines
|   |   `-- return one combined range, including those gaps
|   `-- multi-disjoint: reject directly adjacent ranges
`-- scopedReplacements
    |-- one range can infer its output range from unchanged prefix/suffix
    |-- multiple ranges require one output range per input range
    |-- ranges ordered and bounded; gaps and final tail must match exactly
    `-- empty output: endLine = startLine - 1; emit patch per range

Logical identity across revisions [D+C]
|-- correspondingNodes: same ASCII and structure kind required
|   `-- match unique line + startColumn + endColumn + label
|-- Editor correspondence overlays explicit logical-ref -> output-line claims
|   |-- old ref must exist; output line integer with exactly one node
|   |-- reject disagreement with inferred old-to-new mapping
|   `-- reject multiple old identities claiming the same output node
|-- issueDiagramRevision chooses each node's logical identity
|   |-- supplied identity, else inherited base.nodeRefs via correspondence
|   `-- otherwise allocate node-UUID; parentId points to base revision
|-- deriveDiagram
|   |-- collect allowed refs from supplied same-diagram revisions
|   |-- base refs participate in editor correspondence checks
|   `-- every requested ref must be allowed and map to a unique output node
|-- resolve exposes a structuredClone of the view [M+O]
|   |-- remap node id, parentId, and childIds to logical refs
|   |-- include only active jumps; remap their source contentNodeId
|   `-- remove jump source revisionId and contentHash from the view
`-- importDiagramRevision checks identities before registry.register [O]
    |-- every current content node must resolve to a nonempty string ref
    `-- this check requires unique refs for current nodes

Connection lifecycle [D+C]
|-- Schema: source must be content-node; target may be content-node or box
|   |-- content-node pins displayNodeId, contentNodeId, revisionId
|   `-- side defaults to auto; optional offset is in [0,1]
|-- validateConnectionAnchor
|   |-- resolve grid: display ID recursively through container boxes
|   |-- box anchor needs an existing box only
|   |-- content anchor requires a diagram box
|   |-- strict mode: matching content revision and existing node required
|   `-- allowStale: any differing revision bypasses node existence check
|-- validateConnections enables allowStale on both endpoints
|   `-- at most 2000 edges; reject duplicate edge IDs
`-- reconcileConnections
    |-- remove edges if either display box disappeared
    |-- box anchors pass through unchanged
    |-- content updates require old/new diagram boxes and changed revision
    |   `-- anchor must match the old content revision
    |-- valid supplied node mapping updates node ID and revision
    |-- otherwise, identical ASCII/kind permits positional fallback
    |   `-- match old node's line + startColumn in new content
    `-- failed correspondence preserves the existing, possibly stale anchor
